en.quote: …[Russia is] the last country in Europe that wants to talk about, or even utter, the word “war.”
en.head: Russia invaded Ukraine four days later.
en.body: Russian forces invaded Ukraine on 24 February 2022. Peskov’s remark about not wanting even to say the word “war” was not a specific pledge to avoid force. The contrast is between official rhetoric and state action four days later.
